prediction_teacher.inference: student only; ensemble prepares training pseudo-probabilities

architecture: two independent ImageNet resnet18 encoders; learned global weights; feature concatenation

source_train.cached_prefix: PIL decoding and existing Resize256 only; subsequent Resize is an exact no-op

target_train.cached_prefix: PIL decoding and existing Resize256 only; subsequent Resize is an exact no-op

augmentation: JMDA paired Resize256x256/RandomCrop224/HFlip; eval Resize224x224; VIS ImageNet norm, IR .5/.5
sampler: complete larger-domain coverage; cycle shorter domain; fixed full per-domain batches

dataset_audit.category_support_policy: known target category set; shared compact mapping; no target instance labels in training
